info.title: PawTrust API
info.description: REST API for pet-care tasks, sitter applications and reviews. Register an owner or sitter account, then log in to obtain a JWT. Protected operations use Authorization: Bearer <token>; permissions and acting identity come from the verified token. Lists return complete arrays without server-side pagination. Dates in responses are ISO 8601 timestamps; duration is in hours. Examples are illustrative.
